headline: GOLD TOPS $4,200 AS HORMUZ DEAL IMMINENT — Iran-Oman Framework Trims Oil Risk Premium; Fed Sep Hike Odds Drop Below 50% For First Time
snippet: Gold climbed above $4,200 per ounce Wednesday — a third consecutive daily gain and a five-week high — as Iran and Oman reported near-agreement on a Strait of Hormuz reopening framework, with President Trump saying a deal could be announced as early as Wednesday or Thursday. The geopolitical de-escalation compounds the morning's ADP-driven rally: lower oil prices reduce the Fed's inflation justification for a September hike, with CME FedWatch now pricing the September hike below 50% for the first time since the Fed's July hold — a structural compression of the interest rate headwind to junior gold mining NPVs. Friday's July Non-Farm Payrolls now set up as the definitive directional catalyst; a print below 100,000 could push gold toward the $4,300-$4,400 zone where developer valuations snap back sharply.

headline: DISCOVERY MINING DRILLS 19.35 g/t AU OVER 5.4m AT OWL CREEK — 55-Hole Porcupine Program Confirms Dome, TVZ Resource Estimates On Track For Late 2026 (TSX: DSV)
snippet: Discovery Mining Ltd. (TSX: DSV) reported August 5 assay results from 55 diamond drill holes totalling 17,845.5 metres at its Dome, TVZ, and Owl Creek growth projects in the Porcupine Complex near Timmins, Ontario — with standout intervals at the Hoyle Pond–Owl Creek trend of 19.35 g/t Au over 5.4 metres (including 270 g/t Au over 0.3 m) and 4.72 g/t Au over 24.0 metres (including 12.26 g/t Au over 6.8 m), plus confirmation of down-plunge potential at TVZ's 1210 and 1680 levels. Resource estimates at Dome — which hosts an existing 11.0 million ounce Inferred resource and is expected to become Discovery's second large-scale open-pit operation — and TVZ are both on track for NI 43-101 publication before end of 2026; at $4,100+ gold, the project economics underpinning the modelled resource pit shells are materially more attractive than the price assumptions used when the 11 Moz Inferred was originally calculated.

headline: OUTCROP SILVER HITS 1,554 g/t AG SPIKE AT MORENA — Santa Ana Colombia System Growing Into September MRE Update; Aguilar Vein Expands North (TSX: OCG)
snippet: Outcrop Silver & Gold Corporation (TSX: OCG) reported August 5 high-grade silver-gold intercepts from the Morena and Aguilar targets at its Santa Ana project in Cauca Department, Colombia — with hole DH631 intersecting 0.30 metres at 1,554 g/t Ag and 5.44 g/t Au (2,033 g/t AgEq) at the Aguilar N structure, and DH628 returning 2.21 metres at 103 g/t Ag plus 1.42 g/t Au across the principal Aguilar structure. Both targets are being incorporated into a Mineral Resource Estimate update expected September 2026 — timed against silver's current $61-62 run, which improves the economic cut-off grades used in vein system modelling and should expand the resource's economically relevant footprint relative to the prior MRE calculated at lower price assumptions.

headline: ADYTON RESOURCES BOOSTS GAMETA INDICATED RESOURCES 131% — Wapolu Gold Production Restart Targeted Q4 2026; Dual-Track PNG Strategy Advancing (TSX-V: ADY)
snippet: Adyton Resources Corporation (TSX-V: ADY) released August 5 an updated NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate for its Gameta Gold Project on Fergusson Island, Papua New Guinea — reflecting a 131% increase in Indicated resources through a modest drill program combined with a conceptual mining study re-assessment of cut-off grades. The result confirms Adyton's dual-track strategy: advancing Gameta's resource base while targeting a production restart at the nearby Wapolu Gold Project in Q4 2026. Both projects are held with East Vision International Holdings in Milne Bay Province, which also hosts the Woodlark and Misima deposits, and where costs denominated in PNG kina have been systematically reduced relative to USD gold revenue by currency depreciation — a margin tailwind that distinguishes PNG-based developers from many higher-cost Australian and Canadian peers.

headline: CRITICAL ELEMENTS LITHIUM RESUMES 10,000m DRILL AT ROSE WEST — Forest Fire Pause Lifted; Winter Program Already 3x'd Quebec Pegmatite Footprint; MRE Fall 2026 (TSX-V: CRE)
source_name: Investing News Network / Critical Elements Lithium
snippet: Critical Elements Lithium Corp. (TSX-V: CRE) confirmed August 4 that Phase 2 Summer 2026 systematic drilling has resumed at its 100%-owned Rose West Discovery in Eeyou Istchee, Quebec, following a precautionary suspension due to a nearby forest fire. The Phase 1 Winter 2026 program previously tripled the known mineralized footprint from 450 metres × 370 metres to 1,250 metres × 800 metres, confirming lithium-tantalum-bearing pegmatites in hanging wall and footwall positions of the main Pegmatite 3 zone at typical thicknesses of 10 to 40 metres with excellent lateral continuity. The 10,000-metre Phase 2 program will support a Mineral Resource Estimate planned for Fall 2026 — a key de-risking milestone for one of the few Quebec lithium pegmatite projects with an active drill program while spodumene concentrate market pricing has strengthened in 2026.

headline: ENERGY FUELS (UUUU) Q2: 740K LBS U3O8 PRODUCED H1 2026 — Heavy REE Circuits (Tb, Dy) Coming By 2027 As White Mesa Mill Pivots To Dual Uranium-Rare Earth Hub
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE American: UUUU) released Q2 2026 results August 5, reporting 315,000 pounds of U3O8 mined in Q2 from its Pinyon Plain, La Sal, and Pandora mines in the US Southwest — bringing H1 2026 mined production to 740,000 pounds — while confirming that the White Mesa Mill's heavy rare earth expansion remains on schedule, with terbium and dysprosium circuits operational by end of 2027 and samarium, europium, and gadolinium circuits by end of 2028. The expansion is sized to process monazite from the Donald Project JV in Australia, positioning Energy Fuels as one of the few vertically integrated uranium-and-rare-earth companies in the Western world at a moment when China's 2026 export restrictions on rare earth processing are driving Western governments to accelerate domestic refining capacity at whatever cost.

headline: GOLDSEEK TECHNICAL: Gold-Silver 'Strong Momentum Meets Key Resistance' — $4,200 Gold And $63 Silver Are The Lines That Decide The Next Leg
snippet: GoldSeek published August 4 technical analysis of gold and silver's price structures as the metals approach resistance zones that have marked consolidation or reversal points throughout the 2025-2026 cycle — noting that the current rally is constructively different from prior failed breakouts because it is being driven by multiple converging catalysts simultaneously (labour market softness, geopolitical de-escalation, disinflation from lower oil) rather than a single driver. The analysis identifies $4,200 as the critical first test for gold, with a confirmed break pointing toward $4,350, while silver's $63-64 resistance corresponds to the metal's previous 2026 high — both levels now being actively tested in real-time on the day of publication as the ADP miss and Hormuz diplomacy converge to eliminate the three macro headwinds that capped each prior gold recovery attempt since January's $5,598 record.

headline: LUMINA METALS (TSX: LMCU) ADVANCING PFS AT NOWA SÓL — Three-Project Poland Copper-Silver Drill Program Underway; 604Mt @ 1.24% Cu Primary Resource
snippet: Lumina Metals Corp. (TSX: LMCU) provided August 3 a drilling update across its Nowa Sól, Sulmierzyce, and Mozów projects in western Poland, confirming PFS and Environmental Impact Assessment work is progressing at Nowa Sól (604 Mt Measured and Indicated at 1.24% copper and 38 g/t silver), while exploration drilling advances at all three projects across a 169 km² concession footprint. The company's previously released maiden 308 Mt Inferred Resource at Sulmierzyce (2.09% Cu, 31.85 g/t Ag — 6.4 Mt copper, 315 Moz silver) makes its combined portfolio one of the largest undeveloped copper deposits outside South America, in a NATO country with existing rail infrastructure and proximity to state copper giant KGHM — which has already engaged Lumina in supply deal discussions that could accelerate project finance timelines significantly.

headline: FX EMPIRE: GOLD-SILVER NFP WEEK PREVIEW — ADP + Hormuz Stack The Deck; Sub-100K Friday Print Would Kill Sep Hike And Open $4,350 Target
snippet: FX Empire's NFP week gold and silver forecast frames Friday's July Non-Farm Payrolls as the pivotal catalyst that will either confirm or deny gold's breakout from $4,100-$4,200 resistance — noting that Wednesday's ADP miss (44K jobs vs. 70K forecast) and Strait of Hormuz diplomacy have already reduced September Fed hike probability below the 50% threshold, meaning a payroll print below 100,000 could eliminate the September hike entirely and trigger an upgrade cycle for junior gold developer NPVs still modelled at price assumptions from 2025. The analysis frames the current macro setup as the first instance in 2026 where weak labour data, falling energy inflation risk, and Middle East de-escalation have aligned simultaneously — a three-factor convergence that has historically preceded durable sector re-ratings rather than single-session bounces.
